steps.title: Audit compilation on real dataset claims
steps.status: audit completed; compiler fixes remain separate

items.text: Freeze the current claim texts and parser/compiler versions; use the 2,375-claim annotation inventory, not the older 761-claim file
Run the unchanged compiler and retain accepted programs, rejected claims and unexpected errors
Review about 50 random claims plus a separate difficult diagnostic set, including accepted and rejected cases
Measure compilation coverage separately from meaning preservation; keep parser rejection separate from insufficient media evidence

steps.note: Frozen baseline and current audit artifacts: compilation_audit_20261028. Compiler code is unchanged. Census outcomes and assistant semantic judgments are reported separately; reserved-source claims are excluded from the semantic review.

steps.title: Make original-claim compilation reliable
steps.status: full-corpus run and review completed; compiler remains opt-in

items.text: Specify semantic requirements for 25 real diagnostic claims and 21 controls; flag uncertain readings separately
Implement a common JSON logical form and deterministic compiler, including recursive source content, shared referents, predicate senses and source-aligned temporal fields
Expose simple noun-phrase modifiers and keep opaque phrases explicitly marked
Compare trained SRL, pretrained AMR and direct/SRL-assisted frozen logical-form generation on the fixed development inputs
Freeze before checking new source videos; preserve the first 20-source results, fix structural bugs, and evaluate on ten additional disjoint sources
Review accepted programs as well as refusals; keep executability, diagnostic checks and meaning judgments separate
Fix remaining criticism/reporting scope and nominal media descriptions; require complete original-claim coverage before automatic acceptance
Define context requirements for bare names, labels, omitted subjects and underspecified measurements
Complete wider modifier/reference coverage and rerun a frozen source-disjoint evaluation before selecting a default parser
Freeze all 2,375 original texts; run the prior SRL/AMR compiler over every claim and retain every rejection reason
Parse all original claims with the larger frozen text model; add scoped proposition arguments, group quantities, measurements, noun-phrase relations and explicit context requirements
Run the revised compiler on all 2,375 claims; validate generated programs and review accepted outputs and refusals separately
Publish per-claim outputs, full-corpus statistics and semantic failure examples; do not equate compilation with correctness

steps.note: Final full_compilation_20261029: 1934/2,375 compiled, versus 1,544 previously. These are not correctness counts. Fresh 20-case assistant review: 4 faithful (one mention), 7 partial, 6 incorrect, 3 refused. Source videos overlap development. Sentence rewriting remains prohibited; no new media verification or relation training.

steps.title: Keep meaning and executability checks separate
steps.status: 134 regression checks; full-corpus CPU replay; semantic reliability still unresolved

items.text: Check paraphrases and active/passive forms for equivalent meaning
Check role swaps, modifier attachment, negation, conjunction and source assertions for the intended differences
Check landed versus is landing, was landing and has landed without collapsing them to one temporal condition
Inspect incomplete, completed and interrupted events; progressive evidence must not automatically certify completion
Do not assume a tense swap makes a negative: review the reference time, event identity and phases shown in the clip
Develop fixes on development sources, then freeze the compiler for evaluation on separate sources
Use complete logical-form references to evaluate source scope, roles, modifiers, quote integrity, numeric identifiers and event phases before expanding automatic acceptance
Profile loading, grounding and inference separately for the timed-out checks before weak-label training

steps.note: All selected programs parse as ProbLog. Seventeen of nineteen bounded small DeepProbLog checks complete with the expected unknown output; two exceed the 15-second end-to-end limit. These include startup overhead and do not establish whole-corpus inference throughput.

steps.title: Check useful features from frozen visual and audio models
steps.status: initial pilot completed; usefulness still to test

items.text: Inspect each edit under separate visual and audio policies; audio judgments explicitly provisional
Extract real pre-answer neural representations from both frozen models
Compare matched, mismatched, blank and text-only inputs; retain failed controls
Save exact inputs, prompts, scores, feature vectors and provenance
Confirm audio labels by listening and check feature usefulness across 10–20 reviewed examples

steps.note: This run uses one development clip, one unrelated media control, and 12 proposition probes. It is not 12 independent source videos and does not test a trained feature classifier.

steps.title: Build separate visual and audio evidence trees
steps.status: prototype completed; broader source coverage pending

items.text: Reuse one compiled claim with separate visual/audio observations and verdicts
Keep per-modality reference labels and reasons separate
Combine corresponding predicates before claim logic; preserve unknown and flag conflicts
Test complementary evidence, source exclusion, conflicts and candidate alignment
Extend quoted speech/assertion scope and automatic candidate alignment

steps.note: The real pilot uses depicted colors and non-speech music. Speech word-mention probes expose caption leakage, but their claim compilation is rejected until source/content scope is represented correctly.

steps.title: Prepare a verified pilot with source-video splits
items: Reserve test videos before generating edits

steps.title: Train feature-based relation models and compare baselines
items: Start with a linear classifier and one small MLP
Compare whole-claim, calibrated, independent-relation, and shared-assignment methods
Use claim-level labels and limited diagnostic local annotations

steps.title: Evaluate generalization and inspect errors
items: Measure pair correctness, three-way verdicts, unknown behavior, and cost
Separate parsing, candidate, perception, classifier, and composition failures

intro: Current priority: make original-claim logical forms reliable. The full 2,375-claim census is complete; accepted programs still have semantic errors, so media verification and relation training remain deferred.

temporal_diagnostic.status: historical frozen-v1 diagnostic; new semantic compiler now tests a limited executable temporal extension

semantic_run.status: opt-in prototype; semantic review and held-out evaluation pending

compilation_methods_run.status: fixed-input comparison and focused qualitative review; not a selected production parser

rewrite_fallback.status: reserved; explicitly not to be implemented yet
rewrite_fallback.policy: Improve compilation of original claims first. Consider information-preserving LLM rewriting only later for difficult edge cases or unseen patterns, with semantic checks.

logical_form_run.status: experimental common logical form; not ready as the default automatic compiler
